extracted.name: Spicy Cucumber and Peanut Salad
extracted.description: This cucumber salad with peanuts, garlic, and green onions is packed full of flavor. A sweet-salty dressing featuring spicy Asian chili-garlic sauce brings it all together.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon white sugar, or to taste
1 tablespoon chile-garlic sauce (such as Huy Fong Foods®)
2 medium cucumbers - halved lengthwise, seeds scraped out with a spoon, and thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Heat vegetable oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Add garlic; cook and stir until softened and lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool.

Whisk vinegar and sugar together in a salad bowl until sugar has dissolved. Whisk in chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, coriander, red pepper flakes, and cooled garlic until thoroughly combined. Stir in cucumbers, peanuts, and green onions until coated with dressing. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight before serving.
